notes.title: Full Release 1.0
notes.content: The Last Kids on Earth: Hit the Deck! has officially graduated from Early Access and is now fully released!  Play from more than 400 unique cards and embark on over 30 quests that follow the events of the first book. Create your own cards for each character, and challenge yourself with new difficulty levels!

notes.title: Huge Update! Early Access Release 3
notes.content:
Along with a new character and new tag-team quests, users can now visit the Crafting Table to create new cards, refill consumables and more - check it out today!
